newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo palladium slumps, other metals end firmer.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo palladium slumps, other metals end firmer.

text.p: Yen-based palladium futures settled mostly lower on Wednesday after the benchmark August contract hit a life-of-contract low, following declines in New York overnight, while other metals ended firmer, backed by the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Benchmark August palladium fell to a lifetime low of 435 yen per gram before closing three yen lower at 436 yen. Other futures ranged from six yen per gram lower to three yen firmer.
"During Asian hours, physical buying supported the spot palladium prices, but buying interest in yen-based palladium futures remained thin," a trading house trader said.
